title: Not all fruits belong in the fridge
body: Bananas, citrus fruits, melons, and fruits that are still slightly firm keep better at room temperature. Once they are fully ripe, you can move them to the refrigerator to extend their freshness by a few days.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Where should bananas and melons be stored to stay fresh longer?
choices: In the fridge right after purchase
quiz.explanation: Bananas and melons are best kept at room temperature to prevent them from ripening too quickly or becoming overly soft.

title: Store apples separately
body: Apples, pears, and bananas release ethylene, a gas that speeds up the ripening of nearby fruits and vegetables. Store them apart to prevent everything from ripening too quickly.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Why should apples be kept away from other fruits and vegetables?
choices: They release ethylene, which speeds up ripening.
They need more space to breathe.
quiz.explanation: Apples, pears, and bananas produce ethylene, a gas that accelerates the ripening of other fruits and vegetables.

title: Wash berries just before eating them
body: Strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries spoil quickly if they stay wet. Keep them cool in their container and wash them only right before eating.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: Why should you wash berries just before eating them?
choices: To prevent them from losing their color
To avoid spoilage caused by moisture
quiz.explanation: Berries spoil quickly if they stay wet, as water speeds up their deterioration.

title: Freeze Overripe Fruits
body: Instead of throwing away overripe fruits, cut them and freeze them. They will be perfect later for a smoothie, compote, or pastry.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: What should you do with overripe fruits according to this tip?
quiz.explanation: The tip suggests cutting and freezing overripe fruits to use them later in recipes like smoothies, compotes, or pastries.

title: A bruised fruit isn’t a lost fruit
body: A soft or damaged area can be cut away with a knife; the rest of the fruit remains good to eat. Inspect before tossing.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: What should you do with a fruit that has a small soft or damaged spot?
choices: Cut off the damaged part and eat the rest
Cook it to hide the defect
quiz.explanation: The healthy part of the fruit remains edible after removing the soft or damaged area.

title: Keeping Salads and Herbs Fresh
body: Wrap lettuce, spinach, and fresh herbs in a damp cloth before placing them in the vegetable drawer. They will stay crisp for several extra days.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: What should you do to keep salads and herbs fresh longer?
choices: Store them in a sealed plastic bag
Wrap them in a damp cloth in the vegetable drawer
Leave them uncovered in the refrigerator
quiz.explanation: Moisture helps preserve the freshness of the leaves. A damp cloth creates an ideal environment without excess water.

title: Storing Potatoes, Onions, and Garlic Properly
body: Keep them in a dark, dry, and well-ventilated place, never in the refrigerator. The cold turns the starch in potatoes into sugar and changes their taste.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: Why should you not store potatoes in the refrigerator?
choices: The cold makes them rot faster
The cold turns their starch into sugar and alters their taste
quiz.explanation: The cold converts the starch in potatoes into sugar, which changes their taste and texture.

title: Storage Tip: Potatoes and Onions
body: Do not store potatoes and onions together. Side by side, they sprout and rot faster. Store them in separate places to make them last longer.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Why shouldn't you store potatoes and onions together?
quiz.explanation: Potatoes and onions release gases that speed up their sprouting and rotting when stored next to each other.

title: Tomatoes taste better outside the fridge
body: Cold temperatures destroy their aroma and make them mealy. Keep them at room temperature, away from direct sunlight.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Why should tomatoes be stored at room temperature rather than in the fridge?
choices: Cold reduces their aroma and makes them mealy
quiz.explanation: Cold temperatures alter the structure of tomatoes, reducing their aroma and natural texture.

title: Tired vegetables? Make soup!
body: A slightly soft vegetable is still perfectly good when cooked. Soups, stir-fries, or broths are perfect for using up what's lingering in the fridge.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: What should you do with tired (slightly soft) vegetables?
choices: Cook them into soup or stir-fry
quiz.explanation: Tired vegetables are still good once cooked. Turning them into soup, stir-fry, or broth helps reduce food waste.

title: Dairy products go in the coldest part
body: Store milk, yogurts, and fresh cheeses in the coldest part of the refrigerator, between 0 and 4 degrees Celsius, not in the door where the temperature fluctuates.
source: ANSES, recommandations de temperature du refrigerateur

quiz.question: Where should dairy products be stored in the refrigerator?
choices: In the door to keep them at room temperature
In the coldest part, between 0 and 4 degrees
On the top shelf for better visibility
quiz.explanation: Dairy products should be kept between 0 and 4 degrees Celsius to prevent spoilage, as the refrigerator door has a fluctuating temperature.

title: Understanding 'Best Before' Dates on Yogurt
body: The phrase 'à consommer de préférence avant' on a yogurt refers to a 'best before' date, not a strict expiration date. After this date, a properly stored yogurt often remains safe to eat if it looks, smells, and tastes normal.
source: ANSES, difference entre DLC et DDM

quiz.question: What does the 'à consommer de préférence avant' date on a yogurt mean?
quiz.explanation: This phrase indicates a 'best before' date (DDM), meaning the product may still be safe to consume after this date if it is well preserved and intact.

title: Storing Hard Cheese with Mold
body: If mold appears on a hard cheese, cut about 2 cm around the spot and the rest is safe to eat. For soft or grated cheese, it's better to discard the entire piece.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: What should you do if mold appears on a hard cheese?
choices: Cut about 2 cm around the moldy spot and eat the rest
Freeze it to stop the mold
quiz.explanation: Mold on hard cheese doesn't penetrate deeply, so cutting 2 cm around the spot is enough. Soft or grated cheese should be discarded entirely as mold can spread throughout.

title: Freezing Butter and Grated Cheese
body: If you have too much butter or grated cheese, freeze them. The grated cheese can be used directly in cooking without thawing.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: What can you do with leftover butter or grated cheese?
quiz.explanation: Freezing butter and grated cheese helps preserve them longer without waste.

title: Store milk properly after opening
body: Once opened, fresh milk lasts a few days in the fridge. Always reseal the carton tightly and avoid leaving it at room temperature.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: Why should you reseal the milk carton quickly after opening it?
choices: To prevent the milk from warming up and spoiling faster
To save energy in the refrigerator
quiz.explanation: Sealing the carton quickly reduces exposure to air and heat, extending the milk's freshness.

title: Storing Meat and Fish in the Fridge
body: Raw meat and fish should be stored in the coldest part of the fridge, at the bottom, and on a plate to prevent juices from dripping onto other foods.
source: ANSES, recommandations de temperature du refrigerateur

quiz.question: Where should raw meat and fish be stored in the fridge?
choices: At the bottom of the fridge, on a plate
quiz.explanation: Raw meat and fish should be placed in the coldest part of the fridge, at the bottom, to prevent bacterial growth.

title: Meat, Fish, and Deli Meats: Respect the Use-By Date
body: Meat, fish, and deli meats carry a 'use-by' date. After this date, the health risk increases—do not consume them, even if they appear fine.
source: ANSES, difference entre DLC et DDM

quiz.question: What should you do with meat after the use-by date?
choices: Eat it if it seems fine
Do not eat it even if it seems fine
Freeze it to extend its shelf life
quiz.explanation: The use-by date is a strict safety limit. Even if the meat looks intact, it should not be consumed after this date.

title: Fresh Fish Should Be Cooked Quickly
body: Fresh fish should be cooked within 1 to 2 days of purchase or frozen on the same day if it was very fresh. This prevents spoilage and ensures the best flavor and texture.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: How long can fresh fish be stored in the refrigerator?
quiz.explanation: Fresh fish typically lasts only 1 to 2 days in the refrigerator to avoid spoilage and maintain quality.

title: Freeze Meat While It's Fresh
body: To freeze meat, do it before the expiration date, not at the last minute. Then thaw it in the refrigerator, never at room temperature.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: Why should you freeze meat quickly after purchase?
choices: To prevent it from spoiling before the expiration date
quiz.explanation: Freezing meat quickly after purchase helps preserve its freshness and prevents it from spoiling before the expiration date.

title: Cooked Meat Leftovers
body: Quickly cool a cooked meat dish, cover it, and keep it in the refrigerator for a maximum of two to three days. If you have any doubts about the smell, do not take the risk.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: How long can you keep cooked meat leftovers in the refrigerator?
quiz.explanation: Cooked meat leftovers should be stored in the refrigerator for a maximum of 2 to 3 days to avoid any risk of contamination.

title: Dry and Safe Storage for Pasta, Rice, and Flour
body: Store them in airtight containers in a dry cupboard. This protects them from moisture, insects, and prevents odors from mixing in.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Why should pasta, rice, and flour be stored in airtight containers?
choices: To protect them from moisture and insects
quiz.explanation: Airtight containers shield these foods from moisture, insects, and surrounding odors, extending their shelf life.

title: How to Store Bread Properly
body: Storing bread in plastic softens the crust and encourages mold growth. Wrap it in a cloth or keep it in a bread box instead. Once stale, it’s perfect for French toast or croutons.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: Why shouldn’t you store bread in a plastic bag?
choices: To prevent it from becoming too soft
To stop the crust from softening and mold from forming
To keep it fresher for longer
quiz.explanation: Plastic traps moisture, which softens the crust and promotes mold growth.

title: Freeze bread in slices
body: Slice the bread before freezing it so you can take out only what you need. A quick toast will restore its crispness.
source: ADEME, guide anti-gaspillage alimentaire

quiz.question: What should you do before freezing bread to make it easier to use?
quiz.explanation: Slicing bread before freezing allows you to take out only the amount you need without thawing the whole loaf.

title: Dry goods like pasta and rice last a long time
body: Dry products have a best-before date (DDM). When stored properly, they remain edible long after the indicated date—just check that they have no unusual odor or signs of insects.
source: ANSES, difference entre DLC et DDM

quiz.question: What should you check to know if pasta or rice is still good after the best-before date?
choices: No unusual odor or signs of insects
quiz.explanation: Dry goods like pasta or rice should be checked for any unusual odor or presence of insects to ensure they are still safe to eat.

title: Cool Cooked Rice Quickly
body: Cooked rice left at room temperature can develop harmful bacteria. Refrigerate it quickly and consume it within 24 hours.
source: ANSES, conseils de conservation des aliments

quiz.question: Why should you cool cooked rice quickly?
quiz.explanation: Cooked rice left at room temperature encourages the growth of bacteria like Bacillus cereus, which can cause food poisoning.
